J2 transcript: initial sources and all command/run records retained.
SOURCE cases.lykn attempt 1
;; J2-M01 research harness. All runtime program logic is retained Lykn.
;; :any is intentional at the JSON/JS observation boundary, not an ADT claim.
(bind encoder (new TextEncoder))
(func emit :args (:string label :any value) :body
  (console:log (JSON:stringify #a(label value))))
(func hex :args (:any bytes) :returns :string :body
  (-> (Array:from bytes (fn (:number b) (-> (b:to-string 16) (:pad-start 2 "0")))) (:join "")))
(func unhex :args (:string text) :body
  (Uint8Array:from (?? (text:match (regex ".." "g")) #a())
    (fn (:string part) (Number:parse-int part 16))))
(func ensure :args (:boolean condition :string message) :body
  (if (not condition) (throw (new Error (template "INVARIANT: " message)))))
(func number-text :args (:number value) :returns :string :body
  (? (Object:is value -0) "-0" (String value)))
(func inspect :args (:any value :object seen :number depth) :returns :object :body
  (if (> depth 260) (return (obj :kind "depth-bound")))
  (if (= value null) (return (obj :kind "null")))
  (bind kind (typeof value))
  (if (= kind "number") (return (obj :kind kind :value (number-text value) :finite (Number:is-finite value))))
  (if (not (= kind "object")) (return (obj :kind kind :value (String value))))
  (if (seen:has value) (return (obj :kind "reference" :id (seen:get value))))
  (bind id seen:size)
  (seen:set value id)
  (bind entries (-> (Object:keys value)
    (:map (fn (:string key) #a(key (inspect (get value key) seen (+ depth 1)))))))
  (obj :kind (Object:prototype:to-string:call value) :id id
    :length (? (Array:is-array value) value:length null) :entries entries))
(func tree :args (:any value) :body (inspect value (new Map) 0))
(func error-fact :args (:string stage :any err) :body
  (emit "error" (obj :stage stage :name err:name :message err:message)))
(func serialize :args (:any value) :body
  (emit "before" (tree value))
  (try
    (bind result (JSON:stringify value))
    (emit "serialized" (tree result))
    (if (= (typeof result) "string")
      (do (emit "outputHex" (hex (encoder:encode result)))
          (emit "reparsed" (tree (JSON:parse result)))))
    (catch err (error-fact "stringify" err))))
(func runtime-value :args (:string kind) :returns :any :body
  (cond
    ((= kind "undefined") undefined)
    ((= kind "function") (fn () 7))
    ((= kind "symbol") (Symbol "fixture"))
    ((= kind "nan") NaN)
    ((= kind "infinity") Infinity)
    ((= kind "minus-infinity") (- Infinity))
    ((= kind "bigint") (BigInt "1"))
    ((= kind "date") (new Date "2026-09-12T00:00:00.000Z"))
    ((= kind "map") (new Map #a(#a("x" 1))))
    ((= kind "set") (new Set #a(1 2)))
    ((= kind "sparse") (new Array 3))
    ((= kind "cycle")
      (do (bind value (obj))
          (Object:define-property value "self" (obj :value value :enumerable true))
          value))
    (:else (throw (new Error (template "Unknown runtime value " kind))))))
(func chunks :args (:string text :number size) :body
  (bind bytes (encoder:encode text))
  (bind width (? (= size 0) (Math:max 1 bytes:length) size))
  (Array:from (obj :length (Math:ceil (/ bytes:length width)))
    (fn (:any unused :number index) (bytes:slice (* index width) (* (+ index 1) width)))))
(func byte-stream :args (:any parts) :body
  (new ReadableStream (obj :start (fn (:any controller)
    (for-of part parts (controller:enqueue part))
    (controller:close)))))
(async (func drain :args (:any stream :boolean verbose) :body
  (bind reader (stream:get-reader))
  (bind count (cell 0))
  (try
    (while true
      (bind item (await (reader:read)))
      (if item:done (break))
      (if verbose (emit "record" (tree item:value)))
      (swap! count inc))
    (emit "stream" (obj :status "complete" :count (express count)))
    (catch err
      (emit "stream" (obj :status "error" :count (express count)))
      (error-fact "stream" err))
    (finally (reader:release-lock)))
  (express count)))
(async (func package-stream :args (:string op :string text :number size :string framing :boolean verbose) :body
  (bind module (await (dynamic-import "@std/json")))
  (bind decoded (-> (byte-stream (chunks text size)) (:pipe-through (new TextDecoderStream))))
  (if (= op "concat")
    (return (await (drain (decoded:pipe-through (new module:ConcatenatedJsonParseStream)) verbose))))
  (bind stream (? (= framing "lines")
    (decoded:pipe-through (new (get (await (dynamic-import "@std/streams/text-line-stream")) "TextLineStream")))
    decoded))
  (await (drain (stream:pipe-through (new module:JsonParseStream)) verbose))))
(func materialize :args (:string data) :body
  (for-of item (JSON:parse data)
    (if item:directory
      (Deno:mkdir-sync item:path (obj :recursive true))
      (do
        (bind slash (item:path:last-index-of "/"))
        (Deno:mkdir-sync (item:path:slice 0 slash) (obj :recursive true))
        (Deno:write-file-sync item:path (unhex item:hex))))
    (if (Object:has-own item "mode") (Deno:chmod-sync item:path item:mode)))))
(func file-case :args (:string mode) :body
  (bind destination "outputs/destination.json")
  (bind temporary "outputs/replacement.tmp")
  (bind stage (cell "read"))
  (try
    (bind source (Deno:read-text-file-sync (? (= mode "missing") "inputs/missing.json" "inputs/source.json")))
    (reset! stage "parse")
    (bind original (JSON:parse source))
    (emit "original" (tree original))
    (bind edited (assoc original :n 2))
    (ensure (and (= edited:name "Ada") (= edited:n 2) (= edited:nil null)
      (= (JSON:stringify edited:flags) "[true,false]")) "J-01 independent expected fields")
    (bind text (JSON:stringify edited))
    (reset! stage "write")
    (if (= mode "raw-interrupt")
      (do (bind raw (Deno:open-sync destination (obj :write true :truncate true)))
          (raw:write-sync (encoder:encode "{"))
          (raw:sync-sync)
          (emit "checkpoint" "raw-truncated")
          (while true)))
    (bind temp-path (cond
      ((= mode "missing-parent") "outputs/absent/replacement.tmp")
      ((= mode "unwritable") "outputs/locked/replacement.tmp")
      (:else temporary)))
    (bind file (Deno:open-sync temp-path (obj :write true :create-new true)))
    (try
      (bind bytes (encoder:encode text))
      (bind offset (cell 0))
      (while (< (express offset) bytes:length)
        (swap! offset + (file:write-sync (bytes:subarray (express offset)))))
      (file:sync-sync)
      (finally (file:close)))
    (if (= mode "safe-interrupt")
      (do (emit "checkpoint" "sibling-complete") (while true)))
    (reset! stage "rename")
    (if (= mode "rename-injected") (throw (new Error "injected-before-rename")))
    (Deno:rename-sync temp-path (? (= mode "rename-directory") "outputs/target-dir" destination))
    (emit "written" (tree (JSON:parse (Deno:read-text-file-sync destination))))
    (emit "inputUnchanged" (= source (Deno:read-text-file-sync "inputs/source.json")))
    (catch err
      (error-fact (express stage) err)
      (try (Deno:remove-sync temporary)
        (catch cleanup (emit "cleanup" (obj :name cleanup:name :message cleanup:message))))))))

(bind op (get Deno:args 0))
(bind a (?? (get Deno:args 1) ""))
(bind b (?? (get Deno:args 2) ""))
(bind c (?? (get Deno:args 3) ""))
(cond
  ((= op "materialize") (materialize a))
  ((= op "control-read") (console:log (Deno:read-text-file-sync "inputs/control.txt")))
  ((= op "control-timeout") (do (emit "checkpoint" "busy-loop") (while true)))
  ((= op "control-output") (while true (console:log ("x":repeat 1024))))
  ((= op "control-rss") (await (new Promise (fn (:function resolve) (set-timeout resolve 3000)))))
  ((= op "parse") (try (serialize (JSON:parse a)) (catch err (error-fact "parse" err))))
  ((= op "reject-file")
    (try (bind value (JSON:parse a))
         (Deno:write-text-file-sync "outputs/destination.json" (JSON:stringify value))
         (throw (new Error "INVARIANT: malformed input accepted"))
         (catch err (error-fact "parse" err))))
  ((= op "number")
    (do (bind value (JSON:parse a))
        (emit "token" a)
        (ensure (= (number-text value) b) "number representation")
        (emit "safeInteger" (Number:is-safe-integer value))
        (serialize value)))
  ((= op "exact")
    (do
      (emit "tokenString" a)
      (if ((regex "^-?[0-9]+$"):test a) (emit "bigintFromToken" (tree (BigInt a))))
      (bind contexts (cell #a()))
      (JSON:parse a (fn (:string key :any value :any context)
        (swap! contexts conj (obj :key key :source (?? context:source "unavailable"))) value))
      (emit "reviverContexts" (express contexts))
      (emit "rawJSONType" (typeof JSON:rawJSON))
      (if (= (typeof JSON:rawJSON) "function")
        (try (emit "rawSerialized" (JSON:stringify (JSON:rawJSON a)))
          (catch err (error-fact "rawJSON" err))))))
  ((= op "duplicates")
    (do (bind visits (cell #a()))
        (bind value (JSON:parse a (fn (:string key :any val)
          (swap! visits conj key) val)))
        (emit "reviverKeys" (express visits))
        (serialize value)))
  ((= op "presence")
    (do (bind value (JSON:parse a))
        (if (= b "undefined") (Object:define-property value "x" (obj :value undefined :enumerable true)))
        (emit "hasOwnX" (Object:has-own value "x"))
        (emit "x" (tree (get value "x")))
        (emit "nullishDefault" (tree (?? (get value "x") "DEFAULT")))
        (serialize value)))
  ((= op "keys")
    (do (bind value (JSON:parse a))
        (bind edited (Object:from-entries (-> (Object:entries value)
          (:map (fn (:any entry) #a((get entry 0) (+ (get entry 1) 10)))))))
        (emit "keys" (Object:keys edited))
        (emit "inputPrototypeUnchanged" (= (Object:get-prototype-of value) Object:prototype))
        (emit "editedPrototypeUnchanged" (= (Object:get-prototype-of edited) Object:prototype))
        (for-of key (Object:keys value) (ensure (Object:has-own edited key) (template "missing key " key)))
        (serialize edited)))
  ((= op "unsupported")
    (do (bind value (runtime-value a))
        (serialize (cond ((= b "object") (obj :x value)) ((= b "array") #a(value)) (:else value)))))
  ((= op "order")
    (do (bind value (JSON:parse a))
        (bind first (JSON:stringify value null (Number c)))
        (bind second (JSON:stringify (JSON:parse b) null (Number c)))
        (ensure (= first (JSON:stringify value null (Number c))) "same object determinism")
        (emit "first" first) (emit "second" second)
        (emit "equal" (= first second))
        (emit "firstHex" (hex (encoder:encode first)))
        (emit "secondHex" (hex (encoder:encode second)))))
  ((= op "decode")
    (do (bind bytes (unhex a))
        (emit "inputHex" a)
        (try
          (bind decoder (new TextDecoder "utf-8" (obj :fatal (= b "fatal"))))
          (bind text (? (= b "stream-1")
            (do (bind parts (cell #a()))
                (for-of byte bytes (swap! parts conj (decoder:decode (Uint8Array:of byte) (obj :stream true))))
                (swap! parts conj (decoder:decode))
                (-> (express parts) (:join "")))
            (decoder:decode bytes)))
          (emit "decoded" (tree text))
          (try (serialize (JSON:parse text)) (catch err (error-fact "parse" err)))
          (catch err (error-fact "decode" err)))))
  ((= op "jsonc")
    (do (bind module (await (dynamic-import "@std/jsonc")))
        (bind value (module:parse a))
        (serialize (? (= b "edit") (assoc value :n 2) value))))
  ((= op "canonical")
    (do (bind module (await (dynamic-import "@std/json")))
        (bind first (module:canonicalize (JSON:parse a)))
        (bind second (module:canonicalize (JSON:parse b)))
        (bind bytes (module:canonicalize-to-bytes (JSON:parse a)))
        (ensure (= first second) "canonical order invariance")
        (ensure (= (hex bytes) (hex (encoder:encode first))) "canonical bytes agree")
        (emit "canonical" first) (emit "canonicalHex" (hex bytes))))
  ((= op "canonical-reject")
    (do (bind module (await (dynamic-import "@std/json")))
        (try (emit "unexpectedCanonical" (module:canonicalize (runtime-value a)))
             (catch err (error-fact "canonicalize" err)))))
  ((or (= op "ndjson") (= op "concat")) (await (package-stream op a (Number b) c true)))
  ((= op "stringify")
    (do (bind module (await (dynamic-import "@std/json")))
        (bind source (new ReadableStream (obj :start (fn (:any controller)
          (controller:enqueue (obj :n 1)) (controller:enqueue (obj :n 2)) (controller:close)))))
        (bind framed (source:pipe-through (new module:JsonStringifyStream
          (? (= a "rs") (obj :prefix (String:from-char-code 30) :suffix "\n") (obj)))))
        (bind text (await (new Response (framed:pipe-through (new TextEncoderStream))):text))
        (emit "framed" text) (emit "framedHex" (hex (encoder:encode text)))
        (bind parts (-> (text:split "\n") (:filter (fn (:string line) (> line:length 0)))))
        (bind records (parts:map (fn (:string line)
          (if (= b "valid")
            (return (? (= a "rs") (line:slice 1) line)))
          (? (= a "rs") (template "BAD" line) (template "BAD" line)))))
        (bind stream (new ReadableStream (obj :start (fn (:any controller)
          (for-of record records (controller:enqueue record)) (controller:close)))))
        (await (drain (stream:pipe-through (new module:JsonParseStream)) true))))
  ((= op "stress")
    (do (bind size (Number b))
        (bind start (performance:now))
        (if (= a "records")
          (do (bind text ("{\"n\":1}\n":repeat size))
              (bind count (await (package-stream "ndjson" text 7 "lines" false)))
              (ensure (= count size) "stress record count"))
          (do (bind text (? (= a "depth")
                (template ("[":repeat size) "0" ("]":repeat size))
                (template "\"" ("x":repeat size) "\"")))
              (ensure (<= (encoder:encode text):length 9437184) "encoded input cap")
              (bind value (JSON:parse text))
              (if (= a "string") (ensure (= value:length size) "stress string length")
                (do (bind current (cell value)) (bind depth (cell 0))
                    (while (Array:is-array (express current))
                      (reset! current (get (express current) 0)) (swap! depth inc))
                    (ensure (= (express depth) size) "stress depth")))
              (emit "inputBytes" (encoder:encode text):length)))
        (emit "operationMs" (- (performance:now) start))
        (emit "stress" (obj :kind a :size size))))
  ((= op "file") (file-case a))
  (:else (throw (new Error (template "Unknown operation " op)))))

          (:map (fn (:any entry) #a((get entry 0) (+ (get entry 1) 10)))))))
        (emit "keys" (Object:keys edited))
        (emit "inputPrototypeUnchanged" (= (Object:get-prototype-of value) Object:prototype))
        (emit "editedPrototypeUnchanged" (= (Object:get-prototype-of edited) Object:prototype))
        (for-of key (Object:keys value) (ensure (Object:has-own edited key) (template "missing key " key)))
        (serialize edited)))
  ((= op "unsupported")
    (do (bind value (runtime-value a))
        (serialize (cond ((= b "object") (obj :x value)) ((= b "array") #a(value)) (:else value)))))
  ((= op "order")
    (do (bind value (JSON:parse a))
        (bind first (JSON:stringify value null (Number c)))
        (bind second (JSON:stringify (JSON:parse b) null (Number c)))
        (ensure (= first (JSON:stringify value null (Number c))) "same object determinism")
        (emit "first" first) (emit "second" second)
        (emit "equal" (= first second))
        (emit "firstHex" (hex (encoder:encode first)))
        (emit "secondHex" (hex (encoder:encode second)))))
  ((= op "decode")
    (do (bind bytes (unhex a))
        (emit "inputHex" a)
        (try
          (bind decoder (new TextDecoder "utf-8" (obj :fatal (= b "fatal"))))
          (bind text (? (= b "stream-1")
            (do (bind parts (cell #a()))
                (for-of byte bytes (swap! parts conj (decoder:decode (Uint8Array:of byte) (obj :stream true))))
                (swap! parts conj (decoder:decode))
                (-> (express parts) (:join "")))
            (decoder:decode bytes)))
          (emit "decoded" (tree text))
          (try (serialize (JSON:parse text)) (catch err (error-fact "parse" err)))
          (catch err (error-fact "decode" err)))))
  ((= op "jsonc")
    (do (bind module (await (dynamic-import "@std/jsonc")))
        (bind value (module:parse a))
        (serialize (? (= b "edit") (assoc value :n 2) value))))
  ((= op "canonical")
    (do (bind module (await (dynamic-import "@std/json")))
        (bind first (module:canonicalize (JSON:parse a)))
        (bind second (module:canonicalize (JSON:parse b)))
        (bind bytes (module:canonicalize-to-bytes (JSON:parse a)))
        (ensure (= first second) "canonical order invariance")
        (ensure (= (hex bytes) (hex (encoder:encode first))) "canonical bytes agree")
        (emit "canonical" first) (emit "canonicalHex" (hex bytes))))
  ((= op "canonical-reject")
    (do (bind module (await (dynamic-import "@std/json")))
        (try (emit "unexpectedCanonical" (module:canonicalize (runtime-value a)))
             (catch err (error-fact "canonicalize" err)))))
  ((or (= op "ndjson") (= op "concat")) (await (package-stream op a (Number b) c true)))
  ((= op "stringify")
    (do (bind module (await (dynamic-import "@std/json")))
        (bind source (new ReadableStream (obj :start (fn (:any controller)
          (controller:enqueue (obj :n 1)) (controller:enqueue (obj :n 2)) (controller:close)))))
        (bind framed (source:pipe-through (new module:JsonStringifyStream
          (? (= a "rs") (obj :prefix (String:from-char-code 30) :suffix "\n") (obj)))))
        (bind response (new Response (framed:pipe-through (new TextEncoderStream))))
        (bind text (await (response:text)))
        (emit "framed" text) (emit "framedHex" (hex (encoder:encode text)))
        (bind parts (-> (text:split "\n") (:filter (fn (:string line) (> line:length 0)))))
        (bind records (parts:map (fn (:string line)
          (if (= b "valid")
            (return (? (= a "rs") (line:slice 1) line)))
          (? (= a "rs") (template "BAD" line) (template "BAD" line)))))
        (bind stream (new ReadableStream (obj :start (fn (:any controller)
          (for-of record records (controller:enqueue record)) (controller:close)))))
        (await (drain (stream:pipe-through (new module:JsonParseStream)) true))))
  ((= op "stress")
    (do (bind size (Number b))
        (bind start (performance:now))
        (if (= a "records")
          (do (bind text (String:prototype:repeat:call "{\"n\":1}\n" size))
              (bind count (await (package-stream "ndjson" text 7 "lines" false)))
              (ensure (= count size) "stress record count"))
          (do (bind text (? (= a "depth")
                (template (String:prototype:repeat:call "[" size) "0" (String:prototype:repeat:call "]" size))
                (template "\"" (String:prototype:repeat:call "x" size) "\"")))
              (bind encoded (encoder:encode text))
              (ensure (<= encoded:length 9437184) "encoded input cap")
              (bind value (JSON:parse text))
              (if (= a "string") (ensure (= value:length size) "stress string length")
                (do (bind current (cell value)) (bind depth (cell 0))
                    (while (Array:is-array (express current))
                      (reset! current (get (express current) 0)) (swap! depth (fn (:number n) (+ n 1))))
                    (ensure (= (express depth) size) "stress depth")))
              (emit "inputBytes" encoded:length)))
        (emit "operationMs" (- (performance:now) start))
        (emit "stress" (obj :kind a :size size))))
  ((= op "file") (file-case a))
  (:else (throw (new Error (template "Unknown operation " op)))))

function materialize(data) {
  if (typeof data !== "string") throw new TypeError("materialize: arg 'data' expected string, got " + typeof data);

      Deno.mkdirSync(item.path.slice(0, slash), { recursive: true });

    }

  }

function appendItem(values, value) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values)) throw new TypeError("appendItem: arg 'values' expected array, got " + typeof values);

  return [...values, value];

function hex(bytes) {
  return Array.from(bytes, b => {
    if (typeof b !== "number" || Number.isNaN(b)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'b' expected number, got " + typeof b);

    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
  }).join("");
}
async function digest(bytes) {
  return hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes)));
}
function delay(ms) {
  if (typeof ms !== "number" || Number.isNaN(ms)) throw new TypeError("delay: arg 'ms' expected number, got " + typeof ms);

  return new Promise(resolve => {
    if (typeof resolve !== "function") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'resolve' expected function, got " + typeof resolve);

    return setTimeout(resolve, ms);
  });
}
function environment(root) {
  if (typeof root !== "string") throw new TypeError("environment: arg 'root' expected string, got " + typeof root);

  return { PATH: "/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin", HOME: `${root}/home`, TMPDIR: `${root}/tmp`, DENO_DIR: `${root}/cache`, DENO_NO_UPDATE_CHECK: "1", NO_COLOR: "1" };
}
function command(executable, args, root) {
  if (typeof executable !== "string") throw new TypeError("command: arg 'executable' expected string, got " + typeof executable);

  if (!Array.isArray(args)) throw new TypeError("command: arg 'args' expected array, got " + typeof args);

  if (typeof root !== "string") throw new TypeError("command: arg 'root' expected string, got " + typeof root);

  return new Deno.Command(executable, { args: args, cwd: root, clearEnv: true, env: environment(root), stdin: "null", stdout: "piped", stderr: "piped" });
}
function copyTree(from, to) {
  if (typeof from !== "string") throw new TypeError("copyTree: arg 'from' expected string, got " + typeof from);

  if (typeof to !== "string") throw new TypeError("copyTree: arg 'to' expected string, got " + typeof to);

  Deno.mkdirSync(to, { recursive: true });
  for (const entry of Deno.readDirSync(from)) {
    const src = `${from}/${entry.name}`;
    const dest = `${to}/${entry.name}`;
    if (entry.isDirectory) copyTree(src, dest);
     else Deno.copyFileSync(src, dest);

  }
  return null;
}
async function snapshot(root, relative) {
  if (typeof root !== "string") throw new TypeError("snapshot: arg 'root' expected string, got " + typeof root);

  if (typeof relative !== "string") throw new TypeError("snapshot: arg 'relative' expected string, got " + typeof relative);

  const records = { value: [] };
  for (const entry of Deno.readDirSync(`${root}/${relative}`)) {
    const path = `${relative}/${entry.name}`;
    const full = `${root}/${path}`;
    const info = Deno.lstatSync(full);
    if (info.isSymlink) throw new Error("symlink escaped fixture contract");

    if (info.isDirectory) {
      records.value = appendItem(records.value, { path: path, directory: true, mode: info.mode });
      const children = await snapshot(root, path);
      records.value = (old => {
        if (!Array.isArray(old)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'old' expected array, got " + typeof old);

        return old.concat(children);
      })(records.value);
    } else try {
      const bytes = Deno.readFileSync(full);
      records.value = appendItem(records.value, { path: path, mode: info.mode, size: bytes.length, hex: hex(bytes), sha256: await digest(bytes) });
    } catch (err) {
      records.value = appendItem(records.value, { path: path, mode: info.mode, error: err.message });
    }

  }
  return records.value;
}
function processes() {

function descendants(table, parent) {
  if (!Array.isArray(table)) throw new TypeError("descendants: arg 'table' expected array, got " + typeof table);

  if (typeof parent !== "number" || Number.isNaN(parent)) throw new TypeError("descendants: arg 'parent' expected number, got " + typeof parent);

  const ids = new Set([parent]);
  const changed = { value: true };
  while (changed.value) {
    changed.value = false;
    for (const row of table) {
      ids.has(row.ppid) && !ids.has(row.pid) ? (() => {
        ids.add(row.pid);
        return changed.value = true;
      })() : undefined;
    }
  }
  return table.filter(row => {
    if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

    return ids.has(row.pid);
  });
}

  async function collect(stream) {
    const chunks = { value: [] };
    const reader = stream.getReader();
    const item = { value: await reader.read() };
    while (!item.value["done"]) {
      const bytes = item.value["value"];
      total.value = total.value + bytes.length;
      const keep = bytes.slice(0, Math.max(0, cap - stored.value));
      stored.value = stored.value + keep.length;
      chunks.value = appendItem(chunks.value, keep);
      total.value > cap ? await stop("output") : undefined;
      item.value = await reader.read();
    }
    reader.releaseLock();
    const result = new Uint8Array(chunks.value.reduce((n, b) => {
      if (typeof n !== "number" || Number.isNaN(n)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'n' expected number, got " + typeof n);

      return n + b.length;
    }, 0));
    const offset = { value: 0 };
    for (const chunk of chunks.value) {
      result.set(chunk, offset.value);
      offset.value = offset.value + chunk.length;
    }
    return result;
  }
  async function watch() {
    while (!done.value) {
      const rows = descendants(processes(), child.pid);
      for (const row of rows) {
        known.add(row.pid);
      }
      const rss = rows.reduce((n, row) => {
        if (typeof n !== "number" || Number.isNaN(n)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'n' expected number, got " + typeof n);

        if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

        return n + row.rss;
      }, 0);
      peak.value = Math.max(peak.value, rss);
      samples.value = appendItem(samples.value, { ms: performance.now() - start, rssKiB: rss, processes: rows });
      rss > rssCap ? await stop("rss") : undefined;
      performance.now() - start > wall ? await stop("wall") : undefined;
      await delay(25);
    }
    return null;
  }
  const observedStatus = child.status.then(status => {
    done.value = true;
    return status;
  });
  const results = await Promise.all([collect(child.stdout), collect(child.stderr), observedStatus, watch()]);
  const stdout = results[0];
  const stderr = results[1];
  const status = results[2];
  const ended = new Date();
  const survivors = processes().filter(row => {
    if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

    return known.has(row.pid) && !row.state.startsWith("Z");
  });
  const record = { id: spec.id, attempt: attempt, phase: spec.phase, expected: spec.expected, cwd: root, utcStart: started.toISOString(), utcEnd: ended.toISOString(), command: ["/usr/bin/time", "-l", CLI].concat(args), environment: environment(root), wallMs: performance.now() - start, exit: status.code, signal: status.signal, stopReason: reason.value, outputBytesObserved: total.value, outputBytesRetained: stored.value, maxSampledTreeRssKiB: peak.value, samples: samples.value, kills: kills.value, survivors: survivors, stdout: decoder.decode(stdout), stderr: decoder.decode(stderr), stdoutHex: hex(stdout), stderrHex: hex(stderr), stdoutSha256: await digest(stdout), stderrSha256: await digest(stderr), inputState: before, outputBefore: beforeOut, inputAfter: await snapshot(root, "inputs"), outputAfter: await snapshot(root, "outputs"), sourceSha256: await digest(Deno.readFileSync(`${root}/cases.lykn`)), compiledSha256: await digest(Deno.readFileSync(`${root}/target/lykn/run/cases.js`)), configText: Deno.readTextFileSync(`${root}/project.json`), preparation: { command: [CLI].concat(prepArgs), exit: prep.code, stdout: decoder.decode(prep.stdout), stderr: decoder.decode(prep.stderr) } };
  emit(record);
  return record;
}
const group = Deno.args[0];
const manifest = JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("inputs.json"));
if (group === "controls") {
  for (const kind of ["timeout", "output", "rss"]) {
    const spec = { id: `control-${kind}`, phase: "control", op: `control-${kind}`, args: [], files: [], flags: [], expected: `supervisor stops for ${kind}`, wallMs: 500, outputBytes: kind === "output" ? 4096 : 16777216, rssKiB: kind === "rss" ? 1 : 524288 };
    const result = await runOne(spec, 1);
    if ((!(result.stopReason === (kind === "timeout" ? "wall" : kind)) || result.survivors.length > 0) || result.maxSampledTreeRssKiB === 0) throw new Error("Supervisor control did not establish bounded termination");

  }
  Deno.writeTextFileSync("supervisor-verified.txt", "wall/output/RSS controls passed\n");
}
if (!(group === "controls")) {
  Deno.readTextFileSync("supervisor-verified.txt");
  const blocked = new Set();
  for (const spec of manifest.variants) {
    if (spec.phase === group) {
      if (blocked.has(spec.family)) emit({ id: spec.id, phase: group, notRun: "earlier family cap or harness failure" });
       else {
        const attempt = { value: 1 };
        while (attempt.value <= spec.repeats) {
          const result = await runOne(spec, attempt.value);
          !(result.stopReason === null) && !(result.stopReason === spec.expectedStop) ? blocked.add(spec.family) : undefined;
          !(result.exit === 0) && result.stopReason === null ? blocked.add(spec.family) : undefined;
          attempt.value = (n => {
            if (typeof n !== "number" || Number.isNaN(n)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'n' expected number, got " + typeof n);

            return n + 1;
          })(attempt.value);
          blocked.has(spec.family) ? attempt.value = spec.repeats + 1 : undefined;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

}
function chunks(text, size) {
  if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("chunks: arg 'text' expected string, got " + typeof text);

  if (typeof size !== "number" || Number.isNaN(size)) throw new TypeError("chunks: arg 'size' expected number, got " + typeof size);

  const bytes = encoder.encode(text);
  const width = size === 0 ? Math.max(1, bytes.length) : size;
  return Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(bytes.length / width) }, (unused, index) => {
    if (typeof index !== "number" || Number.isNaN(index)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'index' expected number, got " + typeof index);

    return bytes.slice(index * width, (index + 1) * width);
  });
}
function byteStream(parts) {
  return new ReadableStream({ start: controller => {
    for (const part of parts) {
      controller.enqueue(part);
    }
    return controller.close();
  } });
}
async function drain(stream, verbose) {
  if (typeof verbose !== "boolean") throw new TypeError("drain: arg 'verbose' expected boolean, got " + typeof verbose);

  const reader = stream.getReader();
  const count = { value: 0 };
  try {
    const item = { value: await reader.read() };
    while (!item.value["done"]) {
      const current = item.value;
      verbose ? emit("record", tree(current.value)) : undefined;
      count.value = (n => {
        if (typeof n !== "number" || Number.isNaN(n)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'n' expected number, got " + typeof n);

        return n + 1;
      })(count.value);
      item.value = await reader.read();
    }
    emit("stream", { status: "complete", count: count.value });
  } catch (err) {
    emit("stream", { status: "error", count: count.value });
    errorFact("stream", err);
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  return count.value;
}
async function packageStream(op, text, size, framing, verbose) {
  if (typeof op !== "string") throw new TypeError("packageStream: arg 'op' expected string, got " + typeof op);

  if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("packageStream: arg 'text' expected string, got " + typeof text);

  if (typeof size !== "number" || Number.isNaN(size)) throw new TypeError("packageStream: arg 'size' expected number, got " + typeof size);

  if (typeof framing !== "string") throw new TypeError("packageStream: arg 'framing' expected string, got " + typeof framing);

  if (typeof verbose !== "boolean") throw new TypeError("packageStream: arg 'verbose' expected boolean, got " + typeof verbose);

  const module = await import("@std/json");
  const decoded = byteStream(chunks(text, size)).pipeThrough(new TextDecoderStream());
  if (op === "concat") return await drain(decoded.pipeThrough(new module.ConcatenatedJsonParseStream()), verbose);

  const linesModule = await import("@std/streams/text-line-stream");
  const stream = framing === "lines" ? decoded.pipeThrough(new linesModule.TextLineStream()) : decoded;
  return await drain(stream.pipeThrough(new module.JsonParseStream()), verbose);
}
function materialize(data) {
  if (typeof data !== "string") throw new TypeError("materialize: arg 'data' expected string, got " + typeof data);

  for (const item of JSON.parse(data)) {
    if (item.directory) Deno.mkdirSync(item.path, { recursive: true });
     else {
      const slash = item.path.lastIndexOf("/");
      Deno.mkdirSync(item.path.slice(0, slash), { recursive: true });
      Deno.writeFileSync(item.path, unhex(item.hex));
    }
    if (Object.hasOwn(item, "mode")) Deno.chmodSync(item.path, item.mode);

  }
}
function fileCase(mode) {
  if (typeof mode !== "string") throw new TypeError("fileCase: arg 'mode' expected string, got " + typeof mode);

  const destination = "outputs/destination.json";
  const temporary = "outputs/replacement.tmp";
  const stage = { value: "read" };
  try {
    const source = Deno.readTextFileSync(mode === "missing" ? "inputs/missing.json" : "inputs/source.json");
    stage.value = "parse";
    const original = JSON.parse(source);
    emit("original", tree(original));
    const edited = { ...original, n: 2 };
    ensure(((edited.name === "Ada" && edited.n === 2) && edited.nil === null) && JSON.stringify(edited.flags) === "[true,false]", "J-01 independent expected fields");
    const text = JSON.stringify(edited);
    stage.value = "write";
    if (mode === "raw-interrupt") {
      const raw = Deno.openSync(destination, { write: true, truncate: true });
      raw.writeSync(encoder.encode("{"));
      raw.syncSync();
      emit("checkpoint", "raw-truncated");
      while (true) {
      }
    }
    const tempPath = (() => {
      if (mode === "missing-parent") {
        return "outputs/absent/replacement.tmp";
      } else if (mode === "unwritable") {
        return "outputs/locked/replacement.tmp";
      } else {
        return temporary;
      }

    })();
    const file = Deno.openSync(tempPath, { write: true, createNew: true });
    try {
      const bytes = encoder.encode(text);
      const offset = { value: 0 };
      while (offset.value < bytes.length) {
        offset.value = offset.value + file.writeSync(bytes.subarray(offset.value));
      }
      file.syncSync();
    } finally {
      file.close();
    }
    if (mode === "safe-interrupt") {
      emit("checkpoint", "sibling-complete");
      while (true) {
      }
    }
    stage.value = "rename";
    if (mode === "rename-injected") throw new Error("injected-before-rename");

    Deno.renameSync(tempPath, mode === "rename-directory" ? "outputs/target-dir" : destination);
    emit("written", tree(JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync(destination))));
    emit("inputUnchanged", source === Deno.readTextFileSync("inputs/source.json"));
  } catch (err) {
    errorFact(stage.value, err);
    try {
      Deno.removeSync(temporary);
    } catch (cleanup) {
      emit("cleanup", { name: cleanup.name, message: cleanup.message });
    }
  }
}
const op = Deno.args[0];
const a = Deno.args[1] ?? "";
const b = Deno.args[2] ?? "";
const c = Deno.args[3] ?? "";
async function dispatch() {
  if (op === "materialize") materialize(a);

  if (op === "control-read") console.log(Deno.readTextFileSync("inputs/control.txt"));

  if (op === "control-timeout") {
    emit("checkpoint", "busy-loop");
    while (true) {
    }
  }
  if (op === "control-output") while (true) {
    console.log(String.prototype.repeat.call("x", 1024));
  }

  if (op === "control-rss") await new Promise(resolve => {
    if (typeof resolve !== "function") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'resolve' expected function, got " + typeof resolve);

    return setTimeout(resolve, 3000);
  });

  if (op === "parse") try {
    serialize(JSON.parse(a));
  } catch (err) {
    errorFact("parse", err);
  }

  if (op === "reject-file") try {
    const value = JSON.parse(a);
    Deno.writeTextFileSync("outputs/destination.json", JSON.stringify(value));
    throw new Error("INVARIANT: malformed input accepted");
  } catch (err) {
    errorFact("parse", err);
  }

  if (op === "number") {
    const value = JSON.parse(a);
    emit("token", a);
    ensure(numberText(value) === b, "number representation");
    emit("safeInteger", Number.isSafeInteger(value));
    serialize(value);
  }
  if (op === "exact") {
    emit("tokenString", a);
    if (/^-?[0-9]+$/.test(a)) emit("bigintFromToken", tree(BigInt(a)));

    const contexts = { value: [] };
    JSON.parse(a, (key, value, context) => {
      if (typeof key !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'key' expected string, got " + typeof key);

      contexts.value = appendItem(contexts.value, { key: key, source: context ? context.source ?? "unavailable" : "unavailable" });
      return value;
    });
    emit("reviverContexts", contexts.value);
    emit("rawJSONType", typeof JSON.rawJSON);
    if (typeof JSON.rawJSON === "function") try {
      emit("rawSerialized", JSON.stringify(JSON.rawJSON(a)));
    } catch (err) {
      errorFact("rawJSON", err);
    }

  }
  if (op === "duplicates") {
    const visits = { value: [] };
    const value = JSON.parse(a, (key, val) => {
      if (typeof key !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'key' expected string, got " + typeof key);

      visits.value = appendItem(visits.value, key);
      return val;
    });
    emit("reviverKeys", visits.value);
    serialize(value);
  }
  if (op === "presence") {
    const value = JSON.parse(a);
    if (b === "undefined") Object.defineProperty(value, "x", { value: undefined, enumerable: true });

    emit("hasOwnX", Object.hasOwn(value, "x"));
    emit("x", tree(value["x"]));
    emit("nullishDefault", tree(value["x"] ?? "DEFAULT"));
    serialize(value);
  }
  if (op === "keys") {
    const value = JSON.parse(a);
    const edited = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(entry => [entry[0], entry[1] + 10]));
    emit("keys", Object.keys(edited));
    emit("inputPrototypeUnchanged", Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype);
    emit("editedPrototypeUnchanged", Object.getPrototypeOf(edited) === Object.prototype);
    for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
      ensure(Object.hasOwn(edited, key), `missing key ${key}`);
    }
    serialize(edited);
  }
  if (op === "unsupported") {
    const value = runtimeValue(a);
    serialize((() => {
      if (b === "object") {
        return { x: value };
      } else if (b === "array") {
        return [value];
      } else {
        return value;
      }

    })());
  }
  if (op === "order") {
    const value = JSON.parse(a);
    const first = JSON.stringify(value, null, Number(c));
    const second = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(b), null, Number(c));
    ensure(first === JSON.stringify(value, null, Number(c)), "same object determinism");
    emit("first", first);
    emit("second", second);
    emit("equal", first === second);
    emit("firstHex", hex(encoder.encode(first)));
    emit("secondHex", hex(encoder.encode(second)));
  }
  if (op === "decode") {
    const bytes = unhex(a);
    emit("inputHex", a);
    try {
      const decoder = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: b === "fatal" });
      const text = b === "stream-1" ? (() => {
        const parts = { value: [] };
        for (const byte of bytes) {
          parts.value = appendItem(parts.value, decoder.decode(Uint8Array.of(byte), { stream: true }));
        }
        parts.value = appendItem(parts.value, decoder.decode());
        return parts.value.join("");
      })() : decoder.decode(bytes);
      emit("decoded", tree(text));
      try {
        serialize(JSON.parse(text));
      } catch (err) {
        errorFact("parse", err);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      errorFact("decode", err);
    }
  }
  if (op === "jsonc") {
    const module = await import("@std/jsonc");
    const value = module.parse(a);
    serialize(b === "edit" ? { ...value, n: 2 } : value);
  }
  if (op === "canonical") {
    const module = await import("@std/json");
    const first = module.canonicalize(JSON.parse(a));
    const second = module.canonicalize(JSON.parse(b));
    const bytes = module.canonicalizeToBytes(JSON.parse(a));
    ensure(first === second, "canonical order invariance");
    ensure(hex(bytes) === hex(encoder.encode(first)), "canonical bytes agree");
    emit("canonical", first);
    emit("canonicalHex", hex(bytes));
  }
  if (op === "canonical-reject") {
    const module = await import("@std/json");
    try {
      emit("unexpectedCanonical", module.canonicalize(runtimeValue(a)));
    } catch (err) {
      errorFact("canonicalize", err);
    }
  }
  if (op === "ndjson" || op === "concat") await packageStream(op, a, Number(b), c, true);

  if (op === "stringify") {
    const module = await import("@std/json");
    const source = new ReadableStream({ start: controller => {
      controller.enqueue({ n: 1 });
      controller.enqueue({ n: 2 });
      return controller.close();
    } });
    const framed = source.pipeThrough(new module.JsonStringifyStream(a === "rs" ? { prefix: String.fromCharCode(30), suffix: "\n" } : {}));
    const response = new Response(framed.pipeThrough(new TextEncoderStream()));
    const text = await response.text();
    emit("framed", text);
    emit("framedHex", hex(encoder.encode(text)));
    const parts = text.split("\n").filter(line => {
      if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

      return line.length > 0;
    });
    const records = parts.map(line => {
      if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

      if (b === "valid") return a === "rs" ? line.slice(1) : line;

      return a === "rs" ? `BAD${line}` : `BAD${line}`;
    });
    const stream = new ReadableStream({ start: controller => {
      for (const record of records) {
        controller.enqueue(record);
      }
      return controller.close();
    } });
    await drain(stream.pipeThrough(new module.JsonParseStream()), true);
  }
  if (op === "stress") {
    const size = Number(b);
    const start = performance.now();
    if (a === "records") {
      const text = String.prototype.repeat.call("{\"n\":1}\n", size);
      const count = await packageStream("ndjson", text, 7, "lines", false);
      ensure(count === size, "stress record count");
    } else {
      const text = a === "depth" ? `${String.prototype.repeat.call("[", size)}0${String.prototype.repeat.call("]", size)}` : `"${String.prototype.repeat.call("x", size)}"`;
      const encoded = encoder.encode(text);
      ensure(encoded.length <= 9437184, "encoded input cap");
      const value = JSON.parse(text);
      if (a === "string") ensure(value.length === size, "stress string length");
       else {
        const current = { value: value };
        const depth = { value: 0 };
        while (Array.isArray(current.value)) {
          current.value = current.value[0];
          depth.value = (n => {
            if (typeof n !== "number" || Number.isNaN(n)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'n' expected number, got " + typeof n);

            return n + 1;
          })(depth.value);
        }
        ensure(depth.value === size, "stress depth");
      }
      emit("inputBytes", encoded.length);
    }
    emit("operationMs", performance.now() - start);
    emit("stress", { kind: a, size: size });
  }
  if (op === "file") fileCase(a);

  return null;
}

The final allow-all is script data after `--` and FILE; no implicit grant was inserted. Fake PATH applied only to this recorder; real trials use `/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin`. The CLI's trusted compilation reads/writes its scratch build independently of Deno's application permissions.

## Replay from retained inputs

Use a fresh directory each replay. Run on the pinned native host or explicitly record drift. Host process observation must be available; if ps is denied, stop and use the host's authorized execution route. Do not remove the observer or grant -A. Set `artifact_dir` to the absolute committed artifacts directory before changing cwd:

```sh

printf '{}\\n' > "$trial_dir/project.json"
cd "$trial_dir"
research_env() {
  env -i PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$trial_dir/home" TMPDIR="$trial_dir/tmp" DENO_DIR="$trial_dir/cache" DENO_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 NO_COLOR=1 "$@"
}
research_env "$research_cli" check cases.lykn
research_env "$research_cli" lint cases.lykn

research_env "$research_cli" run --no-prompt --allow-read=./inputs cases.lykn control-read
supervise() {
  research_env "$research_cli" run --no-prompt --allow-read="$trial_dir" --allow-write="$trial_dir" --allow-run="/usr/bin/time,/bin/ps,/bin/kill,$research_cli" supervisor.lykn "$1"
}
supervise controls > controls.jsonl 2> controls.stderr
```

PINNED SOURCE SNAPSHOT canonicalize.ts SHA256 7c2cdff82218c2ff03b6cd9e4166661c9b8ad0aace66ad262e604e011e42caf1
// Copyright 2018-2026 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.

import type { JsonPrimitive, JsonValue } from "./types.ts";
import type { Uint8Array_ } from "./_types.ts";

/**
 * Serializes a primitive JSON value (null, boolean, number, string) to its
 * canonical string representation per RFC 8785.
 */
function serializePrimitive(value: JsonPrimitive): string {
  // JSON.stringify handles null, boolean, and string correctly per RFC 8785
  if (typeof value !== "number") return JSON.stringify(value);

  // RFC 8785 Section 3.2.2.3: Numbers must conform to I-JSON (RFC 7493)
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
    throw new TypeError(
      `Cannot canonicalize non-finite number: ${value} is not allowed in I-JSON`,
    );
  }
  // Handle -0 as "0" (RFC 8785 Section 3.2.2.3)
  if (Object.is(value, -0)) return "0";
  // ECMAScript Number-to-String for all other numbers
  return value.toString();
}

/**
 * Serializes an array to its canonical string representation.
 * Undefined elements become null (standard JSON behavior).
 */
function serializeArray(value: JsonValue[], ancestors: object[]): string {
  if (value.length === 0) return "[]";

  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const elem of value) {
    parts.push(elem === undefined ? "null" : serializeValue(elem, ancestors));
  }
  return "[" + parts.join(",") + "]";
}

/**
 * Serializes an object to its canonical string representation.
 * Keys are sorted by UTF-16 code units (RFC 8785 Section 3.2.3).
 * Undefined values are skipped (standard JSON behavior, RFC 8785 Section 3.1).
 */
function serializeObject(
  value: { [key: string]: JsonValue | undefined },
  ancestors: object[],
): string {
  // Default sort uses UTF-16 code unit comparison per RFC 8785
  const keys = Object.keys(value).sort();

  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const key of keys) {
    const propValue = value[key];
    if (propValue === undefined) continue;
    parts.push(
      JSON.stringify(key) + ":" + serializeValue(propValue, ancestors),
    );
  }

  return "{" + parts.join(",") + "}";
}

/**
 * Recursively serializes a JSON value to its canonical string representation.
 *
 * @param value The JSON value to serialize
 * @param ancestors Stack of ancestor objects for cycle detection
 */
function serializeValue(value: JsonValue, ancestors: object[] = []): string {
  if (value === null) return "null";
  if (typeof value !== "object") return serializePrimitive(value);

  // Circular reference detection: check if this object is an ancestor
  if (ancestors.includes(value)) {
    throw new TypeError("Converting circular structure to JSON");
  }
  ancestors.push(value);

  const result = Array.isArray(value)
    ? serializeArray(value, ancestors)
    : serializeObject(value, ancestors);

  ancestors.pop();
  return result;
}

/**
 * Serializes a JSON value to a canonical string per
 * {@link https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8785 | RFC 8785} JSON
 * Canonicalization Scheme (JCS).
 *
 * This produces a deterministic JSON string suitable for hashing or signing,
 * with object keys sorted lexicographically by UTF-16 code units and no
 * whitespace between tokens.
 *
 * Note: The input must be JSON-compatible data. Objects with `toJSON()` methods
 * (like `Date`) should be converted to their JSON representation first.
 *
 * @param value The JSON value to canonicalize.
 * @returns The canonical JSON string.
 *
 * @example Basic usage (RFC 8785 Appendix E inspired)
 * ```ts
 * import { canonicalize } from "@std/json/canonicalize";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * // Keys are sorted lexicographically, no whitespace between tokens
 * const data = {
 *   time: "2019-01-28T07:45:10Z",
 *   big: "055",
 *   val: 3.5,
 * };
 * assertEquals(canonicalize(data), '{"big":"055","time":"2019-01-28T07:45:10Z","val":3.5}');
 * ```
 *
 * @example Number serialization (RFC 8785 Section 3.2.2.3)
 * ```ts
 * import { canonicalize } from "@std/json/canonicalize";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * // Numbers follow ECMAScript serialization rules
 * assertEquals(canonicalize(10.0), "10");           // No unnecessary decimals
 * assertEquals(canonicalize(1e21), "1e+21");        // Scientific notation for large
 * assertEquals(canonicalize(0.0000001), "1e-7");    // Scientific notation for small
 * assertEquals(canonicalize(-0), "0");              // Negative zero becomes "0"
 * ```
 *
 * @example Key sorting by UTF-16 code units (RFC 8785 Section 3.2.3)
 * ```ts
 * import { canonicalize } from "@std/json/canonicalize";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * // Keys sorted by UTF-16 code units: digits < uppercase < lowercase
 * const data = { a: 1, A: 2, "1": 3 };
 * assertEquals(canonicalize(data), '{"1":3,"A":2,"a":1}');
 * ```
 *
 * @throws {TypeError} If the value contains non-finite numbers (Infinity, -Infinity, NaN).
 * @throws {TypeError} If the value contains circular references.
 *
 * @see {@link https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8785 | RFC 8785}
 */
export function canonicalize(value: JsonValue): string {
  return serializeValue(value);
}

/**
 * Serializes a JSON value to canonical UTF-8 bytes per
 * {@link https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8785 | RFC 8785} JSON
 * Canonicalization Scheme (JCS).
 *
 * This is equivalent to `new TextEncoder().encode(canonicalize(value))` and
 * is provided as a convenience for cryptographic operations that require
 * byte input.
 *
 * @param value The JSON value to canonicalize.
 * @returns The canonical JSON as UTF-8 bytes.
 *
 * @example Creating a verifiable hash
 * ```ts
 * import { canonicalizeToBytes } from "@std/json/canonicalize";
 * import { encodeHex } from "@std/encoding/hex";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * async function sha256Hex(data: Uint8Array): Promise<string> {
 *   const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data.buffer as ArrayBuffer);
 *   return encodeHex(new Uint8Array(hash));
 * }
 *
 * // Create a deterministic hash of JSON data for verification
 * const payload = { action: "transfer", amount: 100, to: "alice" };
 * const hash = await sha256Hex(canonicalizeToBytes(payload));
 *
 * // Same hash regardless of original key order
 * const reordered = { to: "alice", action: "transfer", amount: 100 };
 * const reorderedHash = await sha256Hex(canonicalizeToBytes(reordered));
 *
 * assertEquals(hash, reorderedHash);
 * ```
 *
 * @throws {TypeError} If the value contains non-finite numbers (Infinity, -Infinity, NaN).
 * @throws {TypeError} If the value contains circular references.
 *
 * @see {@link https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8785 | RFC 8785}
 */
export function canonicalizeToBytes(value: JsonValue): Uint8Array_ {
  return new TextEncoder().encode(canonicalize(value));
}

END SNAPSHOT

PINNED SOURCE SNAPSHOT concatenated_json_parse_stream.ts SHA256 e268857f5a9f51f97eb55d30624811783f7d9aae5657a1de07920da9e8788e1c
// Copyright 2018-2026 the Deno authors. MIT license.
import { toTransformStream } from "jsr:@std/streams@^1.1.0/to-transform-stream";
import type { JsonValue } from "./types.ts";
import { parse } from "./_common.ts";

function isBlankChar(char: string | undefined) {
  return char !== undefined && [" ", "\t", "\r", "\n"].includes(char);
}

const primitives = new Map(
  (["null", "true", "false"] as const).map((v) => [v[0], v]),
);

/**
 * Stream to parse
 * {@link https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JSON_streaming#Concatenated_JSON | Concatenated JSON}.
 *
 * @example Usage
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { ConcatenatedJsonParseStream } from "@std/json/concatenated-json-parse-stream";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * const stream = ReadableStream.from([
 *   `{"foo":"bar"}`,
 *   `{"baz":100}`,
 * ]).pipeThrough(new ConcatenatedJsonParseStream());
 *
 * assertEquals(await Array.fromAsync(stream), [
 *   { foo: "bar" },
 *   { baz: 100 },
 * ]);
 * ```
 */
export class ConcatenatedJsonParseStream
  implements TransformStream<string, JsonValue> {
  /**
   * A writable stream of byte data.
   *
   * @example Usage
   * ```ts
   * import { ConcatenatedJsonParseStream } from "@std/json/concatenated-json-parse-stream";
   * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
   *
   * const stream = ReadableStream.from([
   *   `{"foo":"bar"}`,
   *   `{"baz":100}`,
   * ]).pipeThrough(new ConcatenatedJsonParseStream());
   *
   * assertEquals(await Array.fromAsync(stream), [
   *   { foo: "bar" },
   *   { baz: 100 },
   * ]);
   * ```
   */
  readonly writable: WritableStream<string>;
  /**
   * A readable stream of byte data.
   *
   * @example Usage
   * ```ts
   * import { ConcatenatedJsonParseStream } from "@std/json/concatenated-json-parse-stream";
   * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
   *
   * const stream = ReadableStream.from([
   *   `{"foo":"bar"}`,
   *   `{"baz":100}`,
   * ]).pipeThrough(new ConcatenatedJsonParseStream());
   *
   * assertEquals(await Array.fromAsync(stream), [
   *   { foo: "bar" },
   *   { baz: 100 },
   * ]);
   * ```
   */
  readonly readable: ReadableStream<JsonValue>;

  /**
   * Constructs a new instance.
   */
  constructor() {
    const { writable, readable } = toTransformStream(
      this.#concatenatedJSONIterator,
    );
    this.writable = writable;
    this.readable = readable;
  }

  async *#concatenatedJSONIterator(src: AsyncIterable<string>) {
    // Counts the number of '{', '}', '[', ']', and when the nesting level reaches 0, concatenates and returns the string.
    let targetString = "";
    let hasValue = false;
    let nestCount = 0;
    let readingString = false;
    let escapeNext = false;
    let readingPrimitive: false | "null" | "true" | "false" = false;
    let positionInPrimitive = 0;
    for await (const string of src) {
      let sliceStart = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < string.length; i++) {
        const char = string[i];

        // We're reading a primitive at the top level
        if (readingPrimitive) {
          if (char === readingPrimitive[positionInPrimitive]) {
            positionInPrimitive++;

            // Emit the primitive when done reading
            if (positionInPrimitive === readingPrimitive.length) {
              yield parse(targetString + string.slice(sliceStart, i + 1));
              hasValue = false;
              readingPrimitive = false;
              positionInPrimitive = 0;
              targetString = "";
              sliceStart = i + 1;
            }
          } else {
            // If the primitive is malformed, keep reading, maybe the next characters can be useful in the syntax error.
            readingPrimitive = false;
            positionInPrimitive = 0;
          }
          continue;
        }

        if (readingString) {
          if (char === '"' && !escapeNext) {
            readingString = false;

            // When the nesting level is 0, it returns a string when '"' comes.
            if (nestCount === 0 && hasValue) {
              yield parse(targetString + string.slice(sliceStart, i + 1));
              hasValue = false;
              targetString = "";
              sliceStart = i + 1;
            }
          }
          escapeNext = !escapeNext && char === "\\";
          continue;
        }

        // Parses number with a nesting level of 0.
        // example: '0["foo"]' => 0, ["foo"]
        // example: '3.14{"foo": "bar"}' => 3.14, {foo: "bar"}
        if (
          hasValue && nestCount === 0 &&
          (char === "{" || char === "[" || char === '"' || char === " " ||
            char === "n" || char === "t" || char === "f")
        ) {
          yield parse(targetString + string.slice(sliceStart, i));
          hasValue = false;
          readingString = false;
          targetString = "";
          sliceStart = i;
          i--;
          continue;
        }

        switch (char) {
          case '"':
            readingString = true;
            escapeNext = false;
            break;
          case "{":
          case "[":
            nestCount++;
            break;
          case "}":
          case "]":
            nestCount--;
            break;
        }

        if (nestCount === 0 && primitives.has(char)) {
          // The first letter of a primitive at top level was found
          readingPrimitive = primitives.get(char)!;
          positionInPrimitive = 1;
        }

        // parse object or array
        if (
          hasValue && nestCount === 0 &&
          (char === "}" || char === "]")
        ) {
          yield parse(targetString + string.slice(sliceStart, i + 1));
          hasValue = false;
          targetString = "";
          sliceStart = i + 1;
          continue;
        }

        if (!hasValue && !isBlankChar(char)) {
          // We want to ignore the character string with only blank, so if there is a character other than blank, record it.
          hasValue = true;
        }
      }
      targetString += string.slice(sliceStart);
    }
    if (hasValue) {
      yield parse(targetString);
    }
  }
}

PINNED SOURCE SNAPSHOT jsonc-parse.ts SHA256 411fb9ed755013726740a21877e1d2ea6c7e3f3cf3966324d08d3d0f5c9c59a7
// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.

import type { JsonValue } from "jsr:@std/json@^1.0.2/types";
export type { JsonValue };

/**
 * Converts a JSON with Comments (JSONC) string into an object.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { parse } from "@std/jsonc";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * assertEquals(parse('{"foo": "bar"}'), { foo: "bar" });
 * assertEquals(parse('{"foo": "bar", }'), { foo: "bar" });
 * assertEquals(parse('{"foo": "bar", } /* comment *\/'), { foo: "bar" });
 * ```
 *
 * @throws {SyntaxError} If the JSONC string is invalid.
 * @param text A valid JSONC string.
 * @returns The parsed JsonValue from the JSONC string.
 */
export function parse(text: string): JsonValue {
  if (new.target) {
    throw new TypeError(
      "Cannot create an instance: parse is not a constructor",
    );
  }
  return new JsoncParser(text).parse();
}

type TokenType =
  | "BeginObject"
  | "EndObject"
  | "BeginArray"
  | "EndArray"
  | "NameSeparator"
  | "ValueSeparator"
  | "NullOrTrueOrFalseOrNumber"
  | "String";

type Token = {
  type: Exclude<
    TokenType,
    "String" | "NullOrTrueOrFalseOrNumber"
  >;
  sourceText?: undefined;
  position: number;
} | {
  type: "String";
  sourceText: string;
  position: number;
} | {
  type: "NullOrTrueOrFalseOrNumber";
  sourceText: string;
  position: number;
};

// First tokenize and then parse the token.
class JsoncParser {
  readonly #whitespace = new Set(" \t\r\n");
  readonly #numberEndToken = new Set([..."[]{}:,/", ...this.#whitespace]);
  #text: string;
  #length: number;
  #tokenized: Generator<Token, void>;
  constructor(text: string) {
    this.#text = `${text}`;
    this.#length = this.#text.length;
    this.#tokenized = this.#tokenize();
  }
  parse(): JsonValue {
    const token = this.#getNext();
    const res = this.#parseJsonValue(token);

    // make sure all characters have been read
    const { done, value } = this.#tokenized.next();
    if (!done) {
      throw new SyntaxError(buildErrorMessage(value));
    }

    return res;
  }
  /** Read the next token. If the token is read to the end, it throws a SyntaxError. */
  #getNext(): Token {
    const { done, value } = this.#tokenized.next();
    if (done) {
      throw new SyntaxError(
        "Cannot parse JSONC: unexpected end of JSONC input",
      );
    }
    return value;
  }
  /** Split the JSONC string into token units. Whitespace and comments are skipped. */
  *#tokenize(): Generator<Token, void> {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.#length; i++) {
      // skip whitespace
      if (this.#whitespace.has(this.#text[i]!)) {
        continue;
      }

      // skip multi line comment (`/*...*/`)
      if (this.#text[i] === "/" && this.#text[i + 1] === "*") {
        i += 2;
        let hasEndOfComment = false;
        for (; i < this.#length; i++) { // read until find `*/`
          if (this.#text[i] === "*" && this.#text[i + 1] === "/") {
            hasEndOfComment = true;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (!hasEndOfComment) {
          throw new SyntaxError(
            "Cannot parse JSONC: unexpected end of JSONC input",
          );
        }
        i++;
        continue;
      }

      // skip single line comment (`//...`)
      if (this.#text[i] === "/" && this.#text[i + 1] === "/") {
        i += 2;
        for (; i < this.#length; i++) { // read until find `\n` or `\r`
          if (this.#text[i] === "\n" || this.#text[i] === "\r") {
            break;
          }
        }
        continue;
      }

      switch (this.#text[i]) {
        case "{":
          yield { type: "BeginObject", position: i };
          break;
        case "}":
          yield { type: "EndObject", position: i };
          break;
        case "[":
          yield { type: "BeginArray", position: i };
          break;
        case "]":
          yield { type: "EndArray", position: i };
          break;
        case ":":
          yield { type: "NameSeparator", position: i };
          break;
        case ",":
          yield { type: "ValueSeparator", position: i };
          break;
        case '"': { // parse string token
          const startIndex = i;
          // Need to handle consecutive backslashes correctly
          // '"\\""' => '"'
          // '"\\\\"' => '\\'
          // '"\\\\\\""' => '\\"'
          // '"\\\\\\\\"' => '\\\\'
          let shouldEscapeNext = false;
          i++;
          for (; i < this.#length; i++) { // read until find `"`
            if (this.#text[i] === '"' && !shouldEscapeNext) {
              break;
            }
            shouldEscapeNext = this.#text[i] === "\\" && !shouldEscapeNext;
          }
          yield {
            type: "String",
            sourceText: this.#text.substring(startIndex, i + 1),
            position: startIndex,
          };
          break;
        }
        default: { // parse null, true, false or number token
          const startIndex = i;
          for (; i < this.#length; i++) { // read until find numberEndToken
            if (this.#numberEndToken.has(this.#text[i]!)) {
              break;
            }
          }
          i--;
          yield {
            type: "NullOrTrueOrFalseOrNumber",
            sourceText: this.#text.substring(startIndex, i + 1),
            position: startIndex,
          };
        }
      }
    }
  }

  #parseJsonValue(value: Token): JsonValue {
    switch (value.type) {
      case "BeginObject":
        return this.#parseObject();
      case "BeginArray":
        return this.#parseArray();
      case "NullOrTrueOrFalseOrNumber":
        return this.#parseNullOrTrueOrFalseOrNumber(value);
      case "String":
        return this.#parseString(value);
      default:
        throw new SyntaxError(buildErrorMessage(value));
    }
  }

  #parseObject(): { [key: string]: JsonValue | undefined } {
    const target: { [key: string]: JsonValue | undefined } = {};
    //   ┌─token1
    // { }
    //      ┌─────────────token1
    //      │   ┌─────────token2
    //      │   │   ┌─────token3
    //      │   │   │   ┌─token4
    //  { "key" : value }
    //      ┌───────────────token1
    //      │   ┌───────────token2
    //      │   │   ┌───────token3
    //      │   │   │   ┌───token4
    //      │   │   │   │ ┌─token1
    //  { "key" : value , }
    //      ┌─────────────────────────────token1
    //      │   ┌─────────────────────────token2
    //      │   │   ┌─────────────────────token3
    //      │   │   │   ┌─────────────────token4
    //      │   │   │   │   ┌─────────────token1
    //      │   │   │   │   │   ┌─────────token2
    //      │   │   │   │   │   │   ┌─────token3
    //      │   │   │   │   │   │   │   ┌─token4
    //  { "key" : value , "key" : value }
    while (true) {
      const token1 = this.#getNext();
      if (token1.type === "EndObject") {
        return target;
      }
      if (token1.type !== "String") {
        throw new SyntaxError(buildErrorMessage(token1));
      }
      const key = this.#parseString(token1);

      const token2 = this.#getNext();
      if (token2.type !== "NameSeparator") {
        throw new SyntaxError(buildErrorMessage(token2));
      }

      const token3 = this.#getNext();
      Object.defineProperty(target, key, {
        value: this.#parseJsonValue(token3),
        writable: true,
        enumerable: true,
        configurable: true,
      });

      const token4 = this.#getNext();
      if (token4.type === "EndObject") {
        return target;
      }
      if (token4.type !== "ValueSeparator") {
        throw new SyntaxError(buildErrorMessage(token4));
      }
    }
  }

  #parseArray(): JsonValue[] {
    const target: JsonValue[] = [];
    //   ┌─token1
    // [ ]
    //      ┌─────────────token1
    //      │   ┌─────────token2
    //  [ value ]
    //      ┌───────token1
    //      │   ┌───token2
    //      │   │ ┌─token1
    //  [ value , ]
    //      ┌─────────────token1
    //      │   ┌─────────token2
    //      │   │   ┌─────token1
    //      │   │   │   ┌─token2
    //  [ value , value ]
    while (true) {
      const token1 = this.#getNext();
      if (token1.type === "EndArray") {
        return target;
      }
      target.push(this.#parseJsonValue(token1));

      const token2 = this.#getNext();
      if (token2.type === "EndArray") {
        return target;
      }
      if (token2.type !== "ValueSeparator") {
        throw new SyntaxError(buildErrorMessage(token2));
      }
    }
  }

  #parseString(value: {
    type: "String";
    sourceText: string;
    position: number;
  }): string {
    let parsed;
    try {
      // Use JSON.parse to handle `\u0000` etc. correctly.
      parsed = JSON.parse(value.sourceText);
    } catch {
      throw new SyntaxError(buildErrorMessage(value));
    }
    if (typeof parsed !== "string") {
      throw new TypeError(`Parsed value is not a string: ${parsed}`);
    }
    return parsed;
  }

  #parseNullOrTrueOrFalseOrNumber(value: {
    type: "NullOrTrueOrFalseOrNumber";
    sourceText: string;
    position: number;
  }): null | boolean | number {
    if (value.sourceText === "null") {
      return null;
    }
    if (value.sourceText === "true") {
      return true;
    }
    if (value.sourceText === "false") {
      return false;
    }
    let parsed;
    try {
      // Use JSON.parse to handle `+100`, `Infinity` etc. correctly.
      parsed = JSON.parse(value.sourceText);
    } catch {
      throw new SyntaxError(buildErrorMessage(value));
    }
    if (typeof parsed !== "number") {
      throw new TypeError(`Parsed value is not a number: ${parsed}`);
    }
    return parsed;
  }
}

function buildErrorMessage({ type, sourceText, position }: Token): string {
  let token = "";
  switch (type) {
    case "BeginObject":
      token = "{";
      break;
    case "EndObject":
      token = "}";
      break;
    case "BeginArray":
      token = "[";
      break;
    case "EndArray":
      token = "]";
      break;
    case "NameSeparator":
      token = ":";
      break;
    case "ValueSeparator":
      token = ",";
      break;
    case "NullOrTrueOrFalseOrNumber":
    case "String":
      // Truncate the string so that it is within 30 lengths.
      token = 30 < sourceText.length
        ? `${sourceText.slice(0, 30)}...`
        : sourceText;
      break;
  }
  return `Cannot parse JSONC: unexpected token "${token}" in JSONC at position ${position}`;
}

// Copyright 2018-2026 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.

import type { JsonValue } from "./types.ts";
import { parse } from "./_common.ts";

const blanks = /^[ \t\r\n]*$/;
function isBlankSpace(str: string) {
  return blanks.test(str);
}

/**
 * Parse each chunk as JSON.
 *
 * This can be used to parse {@link https://jsonlines.org/ | JSON lines},
 * {@link https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JSON_streaming#Newline-delimited_JSON | NDJSON} and
 * {@link https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7464.html | JSON Text Sequences}.
 * Chunks consisting of spaces, tab characters, or newline characters will be ignored.
 *
 * @example Basic usage
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { JsonParseStream } from "@std/json/parse-stream";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * const stream = ReadableStream.from([
 *   `{"foo":"bar"}\n`,
 *   `{"baz":100}\n`
 * ]).pipeThrough(new JsonParseStream());
 *
 * assertEquals(await Array.fromAsync(stream), [
 *   { foo: "bar" },
 *   { baz: 100 }
 * ]);
 * ```
 *
 * @example parse JSON lines or NDJSON from a file
 * ```ts
 * import { TextLineStream } from "@std/streams/text-line-stream";
 * import { JsonParseStream } from "@std/json/parse-stream";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * const file = await Deno.open("json/testdata/test.jsonl");
 *
 * const readable = file.readable
 *   .pipeThrough(new TextDecoderStream())  // convert Uint8Array to string
 *   .pipeThrough(new TextLineStream()) // transform into a stream where each chunk is divided by a newline
 *   .pipeThrough(new JsonParseStream()); // parse each chunk as JSON
 *
 * assertEquals(await Array.fromAsync(readable), [
 *  {"hello": "world"},
 *  ["👋", "👋", "👋"],
 *  {"deno": "🦕"},
 * ]);
 * ```
 */
export class JsonParseStream extends TransformStream<string, JsonValue> {
  /**
   * Constructs new instance.
   */
  constructor() {
    super(
      {
        transform(chunk, controller) {
          if (!isBlankSpace(chunk)) {
            controller.enqueue(parse(chunk));
          }
        },
      },
    );
  }
}

END SNAPSHOT

// Copyright 2018-2026 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.

/** Options for {@linkcode JsonStringifyStream}. */
export interface StringifyStreamOptions {
  /**
   * Prefix to be added after stringify.
   *
   * @default {""}
   */
  readonly prefix?: string;
  /**
   * Suffix to be added after stringify.
   *
   * @default {"\n"}
   */
  readonly suffix?: string;
}

/**
 * Convert each chunk to JSON string.
 *
 * This can be used to stringify {@link https://jsonlines.org/ | JSON lines},
 * {@link https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JSON_streaming#Newline-delimited_JSON | NDJSON},
 * {@link https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7464.html | JSON Text Sequences},
 * and {@link https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JSON_streaming#Concatenated_JSON | Concatenated JSON}.
 *
 * You can optionally specify a prefix and suffix for each chunk. The default prefix is `""` and the default suffix is `"\n"`.
 *
 * @example Basic usage
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { JsonStringifyStream } from "@std/json/stringify-stream";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * const stream = ReadableStream.from([{ foo: "bar" }, { baz: 100 }])
 *   .pipeThrough(new JsonStringifyStream());
 *
 * assertEquals(await Array.fromAsync(stream), [
 *   `{"foo":"bar"}\n`,
 *   `{"baz":100}\n`
 * ]);
 * ```
 *
 * @example Stringify stream of JSON text sequences
 *
 * Set `options.prefix` to `\x1E` to stringify
 * {@linkcode https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7464.html | JSON Text Sequences}.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { JsonStringifyStream } from "@std/json/stringify-stream";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * const stream = ReadableStream.from([{ foo: "bar" }, { baz: 100 }])
 *   .pipeThrough(new JsonStringifyStream({ prefix: "\x1E", suffix: "\n" }));
 *
 * assertEquals(await Array.fromAsync(stream), [
 *   `\x1E{"foo":"bar"}\n`,
 *   `\x1E{"baz":100}\n`
 * ]);
 * ```
 *
 * @example Stringify JSON lines from a server
 *
 * ```ts ignore no-assert
 * import { JsonStringifyStream } from "@std/json/stringify-stream";
 *
 * // A server that streams one line of JSON every second
 * Deno.serve(() => {
 *   let intervalId: number | undefined;
 *   const readable = new ReadableStream({
 *     start(controller) {
 *       // Enqueue data once per second
 *       intervalId = setInterval(() => {
 *         controller.enqueue({ now: new Date() });
 *       }, 1000);
 *     },
 *     cancel() {
 *       clearInterval(intervalId);
 *     },
 *   });
 *
 *   const body = readable
 *     .pipeThrough(new JsonStringifyStream()) // Convert data to JSON lines
 *     .pipeThrough(new TextEncoderStream()); // Convert a string to a Uint8Array
 *
 *   return new Response(body);
 * });
 * ```
 */
export class JsonStringifyStream extends TransformStream<unknown, string> {
  /**
   * Constructs new instance.
   *
   * @param options Options for the stream.
   */
  constructor(options?: StringifyStreamOptions) {
    const { prefix = "", suffix = "\n" } = options ?? {};
    super(
      {
        transform(chunk, controller) {
          controller.enqueue(`${prefix}${JSON.stringify(chunk)}${suffix}`);
        },
      },
    );
  }
}
